id: \bReady to go to the Anistar Sundial?
en: \bReady to go to the Anistar Sundial?
it: \bPronto ad andare alla Meridiana di Fluxopoli?

id: \bOlympia is a master of Psychic types. Winning against her is impossible.
en: \bOlympia is a master of Psychic types. Winning against her is impossible.
it: \bOlympia è una maestra dei tipi Psico. Batterla è impossibile.

id: \bOlympia said she was waiting at the Anistar Sundial for a Trainer. The gym is closed until then.
en: \bOlympia said she was waiting at the Anistar Sundial for a Trainer. The gym is closed until then.
it: \bOlympia ha detto che aspettava un Allenatore alla Meridiana di Fluxopoli. Fino ad allora la Palestra resta chiusa.

id: \rWill my lover ever return to me?
en: \rWill my lover ever return to me?
it: \rIl mio amato tornerà mai da me?

id: \bOlympia is not ready for you to leave.
en: \bOlympia is not ready for you to leave.
it: \bOlympia non è pronta a lasciarti andare.

id: \bWild Pokémon annoy you, don't they? Of course they do!
en: \bWild Pokémon annoy you, don't they? Of course they do!
it: \bI Pokémon selvatici ti danno fastidio, vero? Certo che sì!

id: \bSave yourself some time and use it.
en: \bSave yourself some time and use it.
it: \bRisparmia un po' di tempo e usalo.

id: Anistar City\nThe starry city marking the hours.
en: Anistar City\nThe starry city marking the hours.
it: Fluxopoli\nLa città stellata che scandisce le ore.

id: \bLooking for a handout? I guess I can give you this.
en: \bLooking for a handout? I guess I can give you this.
it: \bCerchi un regalino? Va bene, posso darti questo.

id: The person who makes paths with starlight.
en: The person who makes paths with starlight.
it: Colei che traccia sentieri con la luce delle stelle.

id: \rNurse Joy: You look like you trust your team very well.
en: \rNurse Joy: You look like you trust your team very well.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Sembra che tu abbia molta fiducia nella tua squadra.

id: \rThat will let you Mega Evolve an Audino.
en: \rThat will let you Mega Evolve an Audino.
it: \rTi permetterà di far megaevolvere un Audino.

id: \bOlympia has been warning of some dangerous event in the future. I'm a little worried.
en: \bOlympia has been warning of some dangerous event in the future. I'm a little worried.
it: \bAstra continua a mettere in guardia su un evento pericoloso nel futuro. Sono un po' preoccupato.
